title: False advertising. Not able to get a refund the first day.
body:
Hey guys! Just a short advice about this app. 
It is nothing more than a to do list with a tracker and reminders. 
You can do exactly the same with the IOS apps.
They made the charge the same day I was going to cancel at 9 am (after free trial) and when the refund was requested, Apple denied it. 
Big DON'T
author: NikiDawi

title: Scam like marketing
body: Thanks guys. So I download the app then it says auto payment... sure let's still give it a go.
